structured-035.derivation: Fixed tables occupy bytes 112..227. Seven length-prefixed strings end at 303; code items align to 304,336,356. invoke-static format 35c has three code units, so repeated sites are PCs 0 and 3. Native static method flags 0x109 require code_off=0. Catch-all handler list is 01 00 02 and try handler_off=1.

class-reorder.derivation: A and B independently extend external Object, so either class_def order respects superclass topology. Sorted string/type/proto/method ID arrays retain mandated ordering. string_data and class_data physical order reverses; string_id offsets and each class_data_off are rewritten. method_id.class_idx always indexes type_ids, never class_def_idx; each native method retains its owner, name, proto, flags and absent body.
